text: Just as "rangastha" (one who is in the color) is simply "rangastha," so too, having considered that there is only one pure being, he said, "I have seen it." Thus, a single, unattached nature, which is the primary cause of the three worlds, and not a secondary nature, because even when the nature and the being are manifested through differences in form and caste, they are still pervasive due to their inherent nature; therefore, there is connection, but not from union. From where does creation arise?
